sections.shortTitle: Sindh Laws Amending and Repealing Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1994
SINDH LAWS (AMENDING AND REPEALING) ACT, 1993
ACT II OF 1994
An Act to amend and repeal certain laws in force in the Province of
Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-16/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Sindh Laws (Amending and Repealing) Bill, 1993 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1993 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Laws (Amending and Repealing) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
